sections.heading: How to wear ?
sections.text:
-> Wear on your left hand to attract positivity, opportunities, and growth energy. Wear on your right hand to project confidence, clarity, and strength.

-> Best day to wear this bracelet is Thursday morning to align with growth, confidence, positive energy, and balanced success.
-> Place the bracelet on a selenite plate for a few hours or overnight. You can also keep it under moonlight to refresh its energy. Recharge once every 7–10 days for best results
-> You can use a soft dry cloth and wipe gently. For energy cleansing, pass it through incense or dhoop smoke for a few minutes. Avoid harsh chemicals and water to maintain shine and quality.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Ever feel like you’re doing everything right, but still need that extra push — a little more confidence, clarity, and positive energy in your daily life?

This bracelet is designed for exactly that.

A thoughtful blend of Pyrite, Black Obsidian, Tiger Eye, and colorful CZ accents, it brings together protection, growth, focus, and a vibrant energy — all in one piece you can wear every day.

Simple, stylish, and purposeful — because sometimes, it’s the small things you wear daily that make the biggest difference.

🔮 What Makes It Special

• 
Pyrite (The Wealth Magnet)
Supports financial growth, confidence, and action-taking energy

• 
Black Obsidian (The Protector)
Helps shield against negativity and keeps your energy grounded

• 
Tiger Eye (Confidence & Clarity)
Enhances focus, courage, and decision-making

• 
Colorful CZ Accents (Vibrance & Expression)
Adds a lively, radiant sparkle — symbolizing balance, creativity, and positivity

Made using 100% true and tested crystals, ensuring each piece carries unique textures, natural variations, and authentic quality, supported by a rigorous multi-step quality testing process.

This bracelet is carefully handcrafted by skilled artisans and brought to you by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand, ensuring both authenticity and fine detailing.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. What is this bracelet used for?

It is designed to support confidence, protection, focus, and positive energy in your daily life.

Q2. Can I wear it every day?

Yes, it’s lightweight and comfortable — perfect for daily wear.

Q9. Can both men and women wear it?

Yes, it has a unisex design suitable for everyone.

Q4. Does it need recharging?

Yes, you can place it on a selenite plate or under moonlight every 7–10 days to refresh its energy.

Q5. Can I wear it while bathing or washing hands?

It’s best to avoid water and chemicals to maintain the shine and durability of the bracelet.

Q6. Is it made with real crystals?

Yes, it features Pyrite, Black Obsidian, and Tiger Eye, along with colorful CZ accents for a premium finish.

Q7. Will it fit my wrist?

The bracelet comes with an adjustable chain, designed to fit most wrist sizes comfortably.
